name: Cynthia Diggs
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: Cindy Diggs is the Founder of the law firm of Diggs & Sadler. A top-rated, award-winning board certified attorney with more than 35 years of legal experience, Ms. Diggs focuses her practice primarily on family law, and she provides invaluable counsel and guidance to clients across her region who are going through a divorce or have other serious legal issues affecting their families.

Board-certified in both family law and civil trial law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Ms. Diggs is able to offer an unmatched level of advocacy and support for her clients, and she has achieved considerable success assisting those she serves in making the best-informed decisions about the legal issues that will affect them and their loved ones for years to come.

At all turns, Ms. Diggs maintains an unwavering focus on protecting her clients' rights and best interests while helping them obtain the positive results they seek as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. She prepares each case thoroughly as if it were to go to trial, but she prefers to help her clients resolve their conflicts and reach favorable agreements without the need for expensive, time-consuming and adversarial court battles. She has extensive experience handling complex asset division cases as well as international family law cases involving expatriates in international custody, support, divorce and jurisdictional disputes.

In honor of her impeccable professionalism and superior client service, she has earned consistent top rankings from H Texas Magazine, Texas Monthly Magazine and other sources along with a Trailblazers designation from Texas Lawyer Magazine and the National Law Journal. In addition, Ms. Diggs has received Superb, 10 out of 10 client ratings on Avvo, and International Advisory Experts voted her a Top-Rated Lawyer in 2019. She also accepted invitations to join both the prestigious American Board of Trial Advocates as well as the International Academy of Family Lawyers, and has served on their boards as well.

While in law school she was inducted into the Order of the Barristers. She also served as associate editor of the Texas Law Review, as well as member of the school's Mock Trial Team and National Moot Court Team.

Among her other professional affiliations, Ms. Diggs is an active member of the Houston Bar Association, the State Bar of Texas, the Texas Association of Family Law Specialists, the Gulf Coast Family Law Specialists, and the Texas Association of Civil Trial and Appellate Specialists. She also has several publications to her credit, and she routinely conducts lectures and seminars on a variety of legal topics. In her community, Ms. Diggs has served on the boards of Stages Repertory Theatre and the Houston Urban Debate League.
